svg.title: Network encapsulation: Packets as nesting dolls
svg.desc: An Ethernet frame contains an IPv4 packet, which contains a TCP segment, which contains application bytes. Each outer layer adds its own header. The boxes show containment, not byte proportions.

g.text: Network encapsulation: Packets as nesting dolls
14-byte header: destination MAC, source MAC, EtherType (without VLAN tags)
20-60-byte header: IP addresses, protocol, length, TTL, and optional fields
20-60-byte header: ports, sequence numbers, flags, and optional fields
May be part of a message, multiple messages, or encrypted data
Header sizes are in bytes. The boxes show containment, not byte proportions.
